verdict.rationale: Drata documents an official MCP server (drata-probe-4) and describes enabling AI agents to interact with Drata via natural language to automate compliance workflows (drata-docs-2, drata-docs-18), consistent with a first-party MCP integration for its developer platform. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the MCP server works as described, and details on setup/auth specific to the MCP endpoint beyond a help article title.
